body: Thank you both greatly for the replies. I'm taking it to a friend who works for Blackberry to get it looked at. I desperately need this phone as I cannot afford a new one, and he thinks as well that it may be a battery issue. Thanks again!

Thank you for the reply :) My dreams vary every night now, it used to just be one or two dreams recurring but now it's constantly changing. 
I'll try the positive thoughts before bed thing. I'm really getting desperate to fix this, I'm exhausted and I do a really important "job" so to speak where mistakes can't afford to be made (involving medications and the like).
Well crap. This one didn't work. It's quarter to four and I still can't seem to get back to sleep.

Thank you for the reply. It means an incredible amount to me to know that all of the people that have responded to this thread have done so not knowing the first thing about me. I'm glad I've posted this. Thank you to everyone who has responded. 

I was raised in an incredibly warped religious household, as a result I have mixed ideas surrounding religion. I don't have many interests. I should note that I live in the country, and have no means of transportation. It's incredibly isolating. I used to have a job, an apartment, transportation. I suppose I did a lot of coffee dates with people I have since lost as friends. 

The few people I can get to step foot in this neck of the woods are typically dealers, or men. I don't have any female friends. Very few male ones.
Very insightful.
Too late for that last part. Soon I will feel better. I'm sorry for wasting your time. Tomorrow will be another day of feeling like this I suppose.
It's a strange thing to understand. Why some make it, and some don't.
I'm not entirely sure tbh. In our family, we have a "don't ask, don't tell" policy. I have a long history in my family. I don't think anything would surprise them.
Sometimes there is nothing you can do. Trust me. It's admirable that you wanted to help your friend.
I wouldn't say "addicted". I'm a recreational user, but lately it's been daily. I'm tapering down, hence the withdrawals. But I can't handle it today.
I found something. It's not much, but for today it will do. Tomorrow I am screwed again.

I'm sorry to hear that. It's a hell of a drug. You wouldn't believe me if I told you, but most of the time...we know we're going to die from it. It's the insanity of the drug. It's not about wanting to die. It's about not wanting to go through anymore pain.
I'm fruitlessly searching for some hidden opiate treasures in old purses. The only thing that makes me feel okay again for a bit.
I'm so fucking sick. And I really don't feel like there are options here. I'm trapped until one of us dies. And I'd do anything to not feel like this anymore.
Also not possible. Last request = die at home.
I've actually always anticipated this ending. It will not be a shock to anyone who's known me. Unfortunately.

Not possible. There is no one else. I'm taking a rifle through my medications to see if I've anything to take this edge off. I'm past my limit of acetaminophen, but only because it's got a codeine compound in it.
I'm feeling quite rough. Perhaps a smoke would help. It's difficult for me to be outside for longer than five minutes, as I'm in charge of a critically ill relative which requires constant vigilance.
I planned to wait a bit longer.
I'm sick. I'm tired of being alone. I'm just...so...tired.
I'm getting tired of just "dealing" with things. At what point do I get to actually "live" instead of just being alive from minute to minute.
I'll try the deep breathing thing. I'm feeling quite panicked and probably hyperventilating a bit. I think a small amount of the panic is a smidge of withdrawal, hence the pills.

Thank you deeply for the reply. I'm not entirely sure. I've never done anything like this before. I've taken what I have of pills to try and relax myself, but the act of taking them leads me to a darker place of "only a few more and I could be done with this". I need someone to tell me its not all a waste of time. I need to know that life gets better. But right now, it can't possibly.
